note: Portable script-to-production parser. One dependency-free file: load it anywhere (browser script tag, node, proprietary pipeline) and call the pure fns. DOM is never required except for the optional readCanvas() helper. Feeding order for foreign systems: fountain text -> parasFromFountain -> breakdown -> toCSV/toShotlistCSV; or editor html -> parasFromHtml -> breakdown.

functions.parasFromFountain: (fountainText) -> [{type, text}]. Accepts standard fountain incl. forced markers (.scene, @Char, !action).
functions.parasFromHtml: (editorHtml) -> [{type, text}]. Accepts the six data-type paragraphs.
functions.parseSceneHeader: (slug) -> {raw, intExt, set, location, time}. set==location; a pipeline cannot tell a built set from a real place from the page alone.
functions.extractTags: (text) -> [{kind, value}]. Inline [kind: value] convention; bare [x] counts as prop. Kinds: props, wardrobe, makeup, vfx, sfx, vehicles, animals, stunts, sound, music, extras, locations.
functions.mentionedNames: (prose) -> [CAPS names]. Convention: characters are introduced in CAPS.
functions.breakdown: (paras) -> {spec, scenes[], sets[], cast[], totals}. Per scene: n, header, intExt, set, location, time, cast[] (speakers), onSet[] (speakers + mentioned CAPS), dialogueLines, actionLines, words, estPages (words/150, 1 page ~= 1 min), tag arrays, transitions[]. extras come ONLY from [extra:] tags.
functions.stripboard: (breakdown) -> {groups, sceneOrder}. Groups by set+time, story order kept inside each group.
functions.toCSV: (breakdown) -> breakdown-rows CSV string. Columns in csvColumns.
functions.toShots: (breakdown) -> [{shot_id, scene_n, set, int_ext, time, size, subject, detail, status}]. Default coverage: one WS master per scene, one MS per speaker, one INSERT per prop/vfx; a scene with neither gets an environmental WS. Status always TODO; the pipeline owns it after.
functions.toShotlistCSV: (breakdown) -> shot-rows CSV string. Columns in shotColumns.
functions.readCanvas: (canvasId) -> [{type, text}] from the live editor. Browser only; returns [] elsewhere.
